Checking it needs a test that references Infrastructure and runs against a real database. The lesson names it only as 'a different kind of test', consistent with depth_notes.

CS4033: "The 'await' operator can only be used within an async method." OrderServiceTests.cs lines 12/25 are `public async Task ...`. xUnit observes the returned Task: with `notifier.Send` removed (fake completes synchronously, so the Assert exception is stored in the Task, not thrown), run gives "Failed ...PlaceOrderAsync_ValidItems_SendsOneNotification", "Failed: 1, Passed: 4".

OrderServiceTests.cs line 42 `Assert.ThrowsAsync<ArgumentException>(... items: [])`; lines 49/54 `repository.Seed(new Order { Id = 1, ... Status = "new" })` then `Assert.Equal("cancelled", order.Status)`; line 62 `Assert.ThrowsAsync<KeyNotFoundException>(() => service.CancelOrderAsync(999))`.

Assertions in OrderServiceTests.cs: Equal("new"), Equal(1, CustomerId), Single(notifier.Sent)+Equal(order.Id), ThrowsAsync<ArgumentException>, Equal("cancelled"), ThrowsAsync<KeyNotFoundException>; none reads the repository. Round 2 run with OrderService.cs lines 19-20 (AddAsync, SaveChangesAsync) deleted: "Passed: 5, Total: 5, Duration: 34 ms". FakeOrderRepository has FindAsync, so the read-back check is possible.

Build output of `dotnet test DonHang.Tests` lists only "DonHang.Domain ->" and "DonHang.Tests ->". issues.text: Unlisted claim (new in round 2): xUnit `[Fact]`/`Assert` behaviour stated without a ledger entry. It is true (xunit 2.9.2 XML docs: FactAttribute is "applied to a method to indicate that it is a fact that should be run by the test runner"; Assert "Contains various static methods that are used to verify that conditions are met"), but it is a specific library-behaviour claim and must be in `claims`.
issues.quote: `[Fact]` marks each method as a test that `dotnet test` runs through xUnit, and `Assert` holds xUnit's checks.
issues.fix: Add claim 12 to .meta.json: "[Fact] marks a method as a test the xUnit runner runs; Assert is xUnit's class of static check methods." kind behavior, version_key xunit, section 5, source_hint: xunit.extensibility.core / xunit.assert 2.9.2 XML docs (FactAttribute, Assert). No lesson text change needed.

issues.text: The code block starts each test with `[Fact]`, and `Assert.Equal` / `Assert.Single` come from somewhere, but the prose never says what `[Fact]` does or where `Assert` comes from.
